title: NewtonArticulationRootAPI (self-collision fallback)
summary: Newton self-collision switch, read on every articulation root when PhysxArticulationAPI carries no enabledSelfCollisions.
producer_scope: Published like any applied API when the Newton schema is registered for population; without the registration its attributes are lost (see the ovphysx Newton schema notes).

columns.name: newton:selfCollisionEnabled
columns.absent: true, unless PhysxArticulationAPI physxArticulation:enabledSelfCollisions is present.
columns.notes: Newton schema attribute (newton-usd-schemas, not shipped with ovphysx). Read on every articulation root when PhysxArticulationAPI is not applied or carries no enabledSelfCollisions, without checking usd-schemas.

notes: The parser reads these columns without checking that NewtonArticulationRootAPI is listed in usd-schemas. The compiled cache reads them but does not support the API: a prim that lists NewtonArticulationRootAPI makes the cache bypass.

Newton's schema makes PhysicsArticulationRootAPI built-ins of this API, and USD population lists built-ins among a prim's applied schemas. The builder writes only what the caller applies, so it requires them on the same prim instead of writing a prim the walker would not recognize.
